1.name: Barrel tube
1.note: The outer shell you hold. Everything else slides inside it.

2.name: Thread bush
2.note: Threaded insert at the front of the barrel that the nose cone screws onto.

3.name: Nose cone
3.note: The tapered tip. It guides the point out and stops it, and it unscrews so you can change the refill.

4.name: Return spring
4.note: Pushes the refill back up. Its force makes the cam turn when you release the button.

5.name: Point
5.note: The socket that holds the ball. Its grooves feed ink to the ball as it rolls.

6.name: Ball
6.note: Rolls on the paper and carries ink onto it. It is the working end of the pen.

7.name: Point holder
7.note: Joins the point to the refill tube.

8.name: Refill tube
8.note: The ink reservoir. It moves up and down with the point and the rotator.

9.name: Ink follower
9.note: A plug of grease behind the ink that follows it down and keeps the tube from leaking out of the back.

10.name: End plug
10.note: Closes the top of the refill tube. The plunger pushes on it.

11.name: Rotator
11.note: The ratchet that turns. Its lugs ride on the cam, and the slot they land in is the state: long slot is retracted, short slot is extended.

12.name: Cam guide
12.note: A fixed sleeve in the barrel. Its alternating long and short slots are the two states of the toggle, and its ridge teeth turn the rotator.

13.name: Plunger
13.note: Moves with the button. Its teeth push the rotator's lugs below the ridges and turn them 30° on every press.

14.name: Button cap
14.note: The button you press. Each press is the toggle's one input.

15.name: Top cap
15.note: Closes the top of the barrel and guides the plunger as it slides.

16.name: Clip
16.note: A springy strip that grips your pocket.

17.name: Ink
17.note: The oil-based paste that the ball transfers to the paper.
